metadata.description: Skills distilled from 19 screenwriting / dramaturgy books (Chinese, American and Japanese) plus two master-work corpora: Chekhov's complete plays and Ozu Yasujiro's screenplays

plugins.name: screenwriting
plugins.description: 13 skills: project workflow & story bible, story structure, premise & theme, character & conflict psychology, dialogue, scene craft, format & adaptation, American case studies, Japanese screenwriting method, Korean & French screenwriting, industry & business, Chekhov dramaturgy, Ozu screenplay style
